verdict.rationale: Bento is an email marketing SaaS with AI features (AI flow builder, hosted MCP server), so a buyer could fairly ask whether customer data is excluded from AI model training. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a no-training policy, or any data-use commitment for AI. The data deletion and anonymization API addresses removal of subscriber records, not AI training use, so it does not count toward this story.
